summary: Both acceptance lines are met and nothing is broken. The unit sweep shows every member clear of every strand across Pulsar, Quasar and Harbor, with 0 fallbacks, and the gallery stills are in the work folder. The fade is untested by eye.

checks.cmd: npx vitest run formationCorridor docTables formationBounds commands
npm run typecheck; npm run lint; npm test

findings.title: The fade (strokeVeiled, veil) is never run
findings.evidence: No fixture merge ends blocked (0 of 441, 532 and 49 checks), so the veil path has no unit test and was not seen by eye (build-1.json limitations). I read the cap polygon and the span merging, and they look right. A mistake would show only on a real blocked merge.

findings.title: echo reads spots.get(m), not spotsOf
findings.evidence: powerLink.ts echo: if a seek reaches the echo without gather or act having run, the veil is silently skipped. The planned places are unaffected.

limitations: I did not re-run the e2e specs or the keystone; I relied on the builder's reported passes (64 and 43).
